inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party; the Nefertari itself is a shared vessel, run by its crew.
The day starts with a hotel pickup in Marsa Alam at 9:00 AM.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The trip takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided alongside the meal and welcome drink.

inclusions.text: Welcome drink on the upper deck
inclusions.source: On arrival at the marina, passengers board the Nefertari and are met on the upper deck with a welcome drink.
The menu centres on seafood and beverages; this is not a buffet situation but a served meal from a dedicated menu.

inclusions.text: Guide narration in the underwater observation deck
inclusions.source: The captain positions the vessel at the best vantage points for the day's conditions, and a guide narrates what you are seeing: the species, their behaviours, the structure of the reef itself.
